pluss::subsp::stats::ts::LagPlanOptions¶

Options describing which lagged features a direct forecaster uses.

LagPlanOptions names the horizons and the lags of the response and of the exogenous predictors.

Fields¶

Field

Type

Default

Meaning

horizon

std::vector<std::int64_t>

{1}

The forecast horizons h; one regression is fitted for each.

response_lags

std::vector<std::int64_t>

{1}

Lags of the response used as features.

leading_predictors

std::vector<std::int64_t>

{}

0-based column indices of predictors whose future values are known.

predictor_lags

std::vector<std::vector<std::int64_t>>

lag 1

Lags of each non-leading predictor (one list per predictor, or a single list applied to all).

leading_predictor_lags

std::vector<std::vector<std::int64_t>>

lag 0

Lags of the leading predictors: lag 0 is the value at the forecast time t + h, lag ℓ the value at t + h − ℓ.

Guidance¶

The defaults are a sensible starting point; change a field only for the reason its row gives.
